* skills are store in the skill subdir (from this file starting)

* on every function, or file you are creating mark it with a text "AI generated by " and add your name and version.
* if the complete file is generated, mark it at the top of the file, if only a function is generated, mark it at the start of the function.
* also add an end marker for that.
* use local temp directory tmp in this workspace
* don't use fish commands in the shell. write bash scripts in tmp.
* use brakets for all one liners, like `if [ -f file ]` and `for i in {1..10}`
* use "#pragma once" instead of include guards for new files
